Escala: cada tablero mide 610 mm (2440 / 4) y ocupa 260 px, así que 1 px = 0.2346 cm. Las
coordenadas se escriben en PIXELES DE LA IMAGEN para poder compararlas con ella y se convierten a
cm con px(). Marco en cm: x hacia la derecha de la imagen, y hacia ARRIBA de la imagen, origen en la

    """Pixel de la imagen -> cm en el marco del simulador."""
    return ((x - X0) * S, (Y0 - y) * S)


def rect_px(x0, y0, x1, y1):
    """Rectángulo en pixeles -> (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) en cm."""
    a = px(x0, y0)
    b = px(x1, y1)
    return (min(a[0], b[0]), min(a[1], b[1]), max(a[0], b[0]), max(a[1], b[1]))


def inside(r, x, y, margin=0.0):
    return r[0] - margin <= x <= r[2] + margin and r[1] - margin <= y <= r[3] + margin

def chaikin(pts, n=2, keep=4):
    """Suaviza una polilínea (las primeras `keep` esquinas se dejan rectas)."""
    head, pts = pts[:keep], pts[keep - 1:]
    for _ in range(n):
        out = [pts[0]]
        for a, b in zip(pts[:-1], pts[1:]):
            out.append((0.75 * a[0] + 0.25 * b[0], 0.75 * a[1] + 0.25 * b[1]))
            out.append((0.25 * a[0] + 0.75 * b[0], 0.25 * a[1] + 0.75 * b[1]))
        out.append(pts[-1])
        pts = out
    return head[:-1] + pts

class Arena:
    """Mapa del piso (raster), alturas y props. line_w en cm (reglamento: 2 ± 1)."""

    RES = 0.25          # cm por celda del raster

    def __init__(self, line_w=2.0, seed=0, card_colors=None, n_obstacles=4, ramp_deg=None):
        """ramp_deg: inclinación de las dos rampas (el reglamento permite hasta 40°); cambia la
        altura de los niveles 2, 3 y 4 (la escalera sigue subiendo 20 cm)."""
        self.line_w = line_w
        self.Z = dict(Z)
        if ramp_deg is not None:
            run = (RAMP1_PX[2] - RAMP1_PX[0]) * S
            rise = math.tan(math.radians(ramp_deg)) * run
            self.Z[2] = self.Z[1] + rise
            self.Z[3] = self.Z[2] + rise
            self.Z[4] = self.Z[3] + STAIR_STEPS * STAIR_RISE
        self.rng = random.Random(seed)
        self.nx = int(math.ceil(W_CM / self.RES))
        self.ny = int(math.ceil(H_CM / self.RES))
        self.grid = bytearray(self.nx * self.ny)
        self.lines = [[px(*p) for p in pl] for pl in LINES_PX]
        self.zones = [(name, rect_px(*r), code, label) for name, r, code, label in ZONES_PX]
        self.green_marks = [rect_px(*r) for r in GREEN_MARKS_PX]
        self.red_marks = [(px(*c), -a) for c, a in RED_MARKS_PX]
        self.dotted = rect_px(*DOTTED_ZONE_PX)
        self.levels = {k: rect_px(*r) for k, r in LEVEL_RECTS_PX.items()}
        self.ramp1 = rect_px(*RAMP1_PX)
        self.ramp2 = rect_px(*RAMP2_PX)
        self.stairs = rect_px(*STAIRS_PX)
        self.flights = [rect_px(*r) for r in STAIR_FLIGHTS_PX]
        self.props = {k: (rect_px(*r), h, kind) for k, (r, h, kind) in PROPS_PX.items()}
        self.walls = [(px(*a), px(*b)) for a, b in WALLS_PX]
        self.room = rect_px(*OBSTACLE_ROOM_PX)
        self.tope = rect_px(*TOPE_PX)
        self.m1_zone = rect_px(*M1_ZONE_PX)
        self.holes = [px(*h) for h in BAR_HOLES_PX]
        if card_colors is None:
            card_colors = CARD_COLORS[:]
            self.rng.shuffle(card_colors)
        self.card_colors = card_colors
        self.cards = []
        for (hx, _), color in zip(BAR_HOLES_PX, card_colors):
            cx, cy = px(hx, 415)
            self.cards.append(((cx - CARD_SIZE[0] / 2, cy - CARD_SIZE[1] / 2,
                                cx + CARD_SIZE[0] / 2, cy + CARD_SIZE[1] / 2), color))
        self.obstacles = self._place_obstacles(n_obstacles)
        self._rasterize()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ construcción
    def _place_obstacles(self, n):
        r = self.room
        out = []
        for _ in range(n):
            x = self.rng.uniform(r[0] + 8, r[2] - 8)
            y = self.rng.uniform(r[1] + 8, r[3] - 8)
            h = OBSTACLE_SIZE / 2
            out.append((x - h, y - h, x + h, y + h))
        return out

    def _cell(self, x, y):
        i = int(x / self.RES)
        j = int(y / self.RES)
        if 0 <= i < self.nx and 0 <= j < self.ny:
            return j * self.nx + i
        return -1

    def _fill_rect(self, r, code):
        i0 = max(0, int(r[0] / self.RES))
        i1 = min(self.nx - 1, int(r[2] / self.RES))
        j0 = max(0, int(r[1] / self.RES))
        j1 = min(self.ny - 1, int(r[3] / self.RES))
        for j in range(j0, j1 + 1):
            base = j * self.nx
            for i in range(i0, i1 + 1):
                self.grid[base + i] = code

    def _fill_poly(self, poly, code):
        xs = [p[0] for p in poly]
        ys = [p[1] for p in poly]
        for j in range(max(0, int(min(ys) / self.RES)), min(self.ny, int(max(ys) / self.RES) + 1)):
            for i in range(max(0, int(min(xs) / self.RES)), min(self.nx, int(max(xs) / self.RES) + 1)):
                if point_in_poly((i + 0.5) * self.RES, (j + 0.5) * self.RES, poly):
                    self.grid[j * self.nx + i] = code

    def _stroke(self, a, b, half, code):
        x0, x1 = min(a[0], b[0]) - half, max(a[0], b[0]) + half
        y0, y1 = min(a[1], b[1]) - half, max(a[1], b[1]) + half
        for j in range(max(0, int(y0 / self.RES)), min(self.ny, int(y1 / self.RES) + 1)):
            yc = (j + 0.5) * self.RES
            for i in range(max(0, int(x0 / self.RES)), min(self.nx, int(x1 / self.RES) + 1)):
                if seg_dist((i + 0.5) * self.RES, yc, a, b) <= half:
                    self.grid[j * self.nx + i] = code

    def _rasterize(self):
        self._fill_rect(self.ramp1, 1)
        for name, r, code, _ in self.zones:
            self._fill_rect(r, code)
        for r in self.green_marks:
            self._fill_rect(r, 5)
        for poly in self.red_mark_polys():
            self._fill_poly(poly, 3)
        half = self.line_w / 2.0
        for pl in self.lines:
            for a, b in zip(pl[:-1], pl[1:]):
                self._stroke(a, b, half, 2)
        for r, color in self.cards:
            self._fill_rect(r, COLOR_CODE[color])

    def red_mark_polys(self):
        out = []
        w, h = RED_MARK_SIZE
        for (cx, cy), ang in self.red_marks:
            out.append(rect_poly(cx, cy, math.radians(ang), w, h))
        return out

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ consultas
    def material(self, x, y):
        k = self._cell(x, y)
        if k < 0:
            return 0
        return self.grid[k]

    def height(self, x, y):
        """Altura del piso (cm) en (x, y), o None fuera de la arena."""
        if not (0 <= x <= W_CM and 0 <= y <= H_CM):
            return None
        if inside(self.ramp1, x, y):
            f = (x - self.ramp1[0]) / (self.ramp1[2] - self.ramp1[0])
            return self.Z[1] + f * (self.Z[2] - self.Z[1])
        if inside(self.ramp2, x, y):
            f = (self.ramp2[3] - y) / (self.ramp2[3] - self.ramp2[1])
            return self.Z[2] + f * (self.Z[3] - self.Z[2])
        if inside(self.stairs, x, y):
            f = (self.stairs[2] - x) / (self.stairs[2] - self.stairs[0])
            return self.Z[3] + f * (self.Z[4] - self.Z[3])
        for lvl in (1, 2, 3, 4):
            if inside(self.levels[lvl], x, y):
                return self.Z[lvl]
        return None

    def surface(self, x, y):
        """Nombre de la superficie: 1..4 (nivel plano), 'ramp1', 'ramp2', 'stairs' o None."""
        if not (0 <= x <= W_CM and 0 <= y <= H_CM):
            return None
        if inside(self.ramp1, x, y):
            return "ramp1"
        if inside(self.ramp2, x, y):
            return "ramp2"
        if inside(self.stairs, x, y):
            return "stairs"
        for lvl in (1, 2, 3, 4):
            if inside(self.levels[lvl], x, y):
                return lvl
        return None

    def zone_at(self, x, y):
        for name, r, code, label in self.zones:
            if inside(r, x, y):
                return label
        return None

    def start_pose(self, level):
        x, y, yaw = START_POSES_PX[level]
        cx, cy = px(x, y)
        return cx, cy, yaw

    def to_json(self):
        """Datos de dibujo para el visor HTML (todo en cm)."""
        return {
            "w": W_CM, "h": H_CM, "line_w": self.line_w,
            "lines": self.lines,
            "zones": [{"color": n, "rect": r, "code": c, "label": l} for n, r, c, l in self.zones],
            "green_marks": self.green_marks,
            "red_marks": self.red_mark_polys(),
            "dotted": self.dotted,
            "levels": {str(k): r for k, r in self.levels.items()},
            "z": {str(k): round(v, 1) for k, v in self.Z.items()},
            "ramps": [self.ramp1, self.ramp2],
            "stairs": self.stairs, "flights": self.flights,
            "props": {k: {"rect": r, "h": h,
                          "base": self.height((r[0] + r[2]) / 2, (r[1] + r[3]) / 2) or 0.0}
                      for k, (r, h, _) in self.props.items()},
            "prism_h": PRISM_H, "stair_steps": STAIR_STEPS,
            "walls": self.walls, "room": self.room, "tope": self.tope,
            "obstacles": self.obstacles,
            "holes": self.holes,
            "cards": [{"rect": r, "color": c} for r, c in self.cards],
            "m1_zone": self.m1_zone,
        }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- geometría 2D
def seg_dist(x, y, a, b):
    ax, ay = a
    bx, by = b
    dx, dy = bx - ax, by - ay
    L2 = dx * dx + dy * dy
    if L2 == 0:
        return math.hypot(x - ax, y - ay)
    t = ((x - ax) * dx + (y - ay) * dy) / L2
    t = 0 if t < 0 else (1 if t > 1 else t)
    return math.hypot(x - (ax + t * dx), y - (ay + t * dy))


def point_in_poly(x, y, poly):
    inside_ = False
    n = len(poly)
    j = n - 1
    for i in range(n):
        xi, yi = poly[i]
        xj, yj = poly[j]
        if (yi > y) != (yj > y) and x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi + 1e-12) + xi:
            inside_ = not inside_
        j = i
    return inside_


def rect_poly(cx, cy, ang, length, width):
    """Rectángulo orientado: centro, ángulo (rad), largo (a lo largo de ang) y ancho."""
    c, s = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
    hl, hw = length / 2.0, width / 2.0
    return [(cx + c * dx - s * dy, cy + s * dx + c * dy)
            for dx, dy in ((hl, hw), (-hl, hw), (-hl, -hw), (hl, -hw))]


def rect_to_poly(r):
    return [(r[0], r[1]), (r[2], r[1]), (r[2], r[3]), (r[0], r[3])]


def polys_overlap(p, q):
    """Separación de ejes (SAT) para dos polígonos convexos."""
    for poly in (p, q):
        n = len(poly)
        for i in range(n):
            x1, y1 = poly[i]
            x2, y2 = poly[(i + 1) % n]
            nx, ny = y1 - y2, x2 - x1
            a = [nx * x + ny * y for x, y in p]
            b = [nx * x + ny * y for x, y in q]
            if max(a) < min(b) or max(b) < min(a):
                return False
    return True


def poly_seg_overlap(poly, a, b):
    return polys_overlap(poly, [a, b])

"""Simulador EN VIVO: corre el programa de competencia real (software/robot/rover_x_auto.py) con
los botones del CyberPi y la recolocación del equipo.

    python3 simulation/live.py            # abre http://127.0.0.1:8770
    python3 simulation/live.py --level 2 --noise 1 --port 8771 --no-open

En la página:
- **Joystick ↑ ↓ ← →**: elegir el nivel en la pantalla de inicio (↑ 1, ↓ 2, ← 3, → 4).
- **B**: arrancar el tramo (cfg.START_BUTTON). **A**: abortar durante el autónomo
  (cfg.ABORT_BUTTON) o control manual en la pantalla de inicio. **Centro**: ajustes.
- **Colocar en la zona**: lo que hace el equipo al pedir reinicio: coloca el robot en la zona del
  nivel elegido en la pantalla (si está corriendo, primero lo aborta; si se cayó, lo levanta).
  Regla del cubo: colocarlo en el nivel 2 o más con el cubo en la garra se lo quita.
- **Pausa**, **velocidad** y **Nueva corrida** (nivel, semilla, ruido).

Solo usa la biblioteca estándar de Python.
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
import threading
import time
import types
import webbrowser
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

import run_auto as ra          # pone las rutas de software/ y tests/fakes, y P0 / CAL0
from run_auto import ROOT
from run_auto import world, cfg, geo, hal, lf, gripper, autonomous, ms
import arena as ar
import physics
import referee
import viewer
import userprog
import manual_arena
import manual_sim

REAL_SLEEP = time.sleep


class Stop(BaseException):
    """Termina el hilo del programa (nueva corrida). No la atrapa el código del robot."""


class Session:
    def __init__(self, level=1, seed=0, noise=0.0, line_w=2.0, mode="comp", source=None,
                 prog_name=None):
        # mode: "comp" = programa de competencia, "manual" = solo control manual (gamepad),
        # "user" = programa subido por el usuario (source)
        import copy
        cfg.P.clear()
        cfg.P.update(copy.deepcopy(ra.P0))
        cfg.LINE_CAL.clear()
        cfg.LINE_CAL.update(copy.deepcopy(ra.CAL0))
        cfg.SEGMENTS = True
        import tempfile
        cfg.PARAMS_FILE = str(Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "rover_live_params.json")
        try:                                # cada corrida empieza con los valores de config.py
            Path(cfg.PARAMS_FILE).unlink()
        except OSError:
            pass
        self.level = level
        self.mode = mode if source is None else "user"
        self.source = source
        self.prog_name = prog_name or ""
        self.params = {"level": level, "seed": seed, "noise": noise, "line_w": line_w,
                       "mode": self.mode, "program": self.prog_name}
        self.log = []
        if self.mode == "manual":           # misiones de alianza: la arena MANUAL del reglamento
            self.arena = manual_arena.ManualArena(seed=seed)
            self.sim = manual_sim.ManualSim(world, cfg, geo, self.arena, level=level, noise=noise,
                                            seed=seed, log=self.log)
            self.ref = manual_sim.ManualReferee(self.sim)
        else:
            self.arena = ar.Arena(line_w=line_w, seed=seed)
            self.sim = physics.Sim(world, cfg, geo, self.arena, level=level, noise=noise,
                                   seed=seed, log=self.log)
            self.ref = referee.Referee(self.sim, ms.MISSIONS, level)
        self.sim.restarts = []
        self.sim.falls = 0
        self.frames = []
        self.label = ""
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.speed = 1.0
        self.paused = False
        self.stop = False
        self.releases = []                  # (t, botón) para soltar botones
        self.pending = []                   # órdenes del usuario para el hilo del programa
        self.state = ""
        self.aborting = False
        self.placed_at = None
        self.results = []
        self.sim.on_frame = self._on_frame
        self.runner = None
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ reloj y cuadros
    def sleep(self, dt):
        if self.stop:
            raise Stop()
        while self.paused and not self.stop:
            REAL_SLEEP(0.05)
        self._service()
        lvl = self.screen_level()
        if self.aborting and lvl is not None:
            self.aborting = False
        # colocado por el equipo y luego se eligió otro nivel con el joystick: mover a esa zona
        if lvl is None:
            self.placed_at = None
        elif self.placed_at is not None and lvl != self.placed_at:
            self.place(lvl)
        self.sim.sleep(dt)
        for t, b in list(self.releases):
            if world.t >= t:
                world.pressed.discard(b)
                self.releases.remove((t, b))
        REAL_SLEEP(dt / max(0.1, self.speed))

    def _on_frame(self):
        self.ref.update()
        with self.lock:
            self.frames.append(ra.frame_of(self.sim, self.label))

    def press(self, b, hold=0.15):
        world.pressed.add(b)
        self.releases.append((world.t + hold, b))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ equipo
    def zone_level(self):
        climbed = sum(1 for mid in (3, 6, 9) if mid in self.ref.done)
        return max(1, min(4, 1 + climbed))

    def screen_level(self):
        """Nivel elegido en la pantalla de inicio, o None si no está en ella."""
        lab = world.labels.get(0, "")
        if lab.startswith("Nivel "):
            try:
                return int(lab.split()[1])
            except ValueError:
                return None
        return None

    def place(self, lvl):
        world.pressed.clear()
        self.placed_at = lvl
        self.sim.place(lvl)
        self.sim.restarts.append(lvl)
        self.log.append((world.t, "EQUIPO: coloca el robot en la zona del nivel %d" % lvl))
        hal.clear_abort()

    def command(self, b):
        with self.lock:
            self.pending.append(b)

    def _service(self):
        """Órdenes del usuario que se aplican en el hilo del programa (entre pasos de física)."""
        with self.lock:
            want = "place" in self.pending
        if not want:
            return
        if self.mode == "manual":          # sin menú: va directo a la zona marcada
            with self.lock:
                self.pending.remove("place")
            self.place(self.level)
            return
        lvl = self.screen_level()
        if lvl is not None:
            with self.lock:
                self.pending.remove("place")
            self.place(lvl)
        elif not self.aborting:
            self.aborting = True
            self.press(cfg.ABORT_BUTTON, hold=0.3)     # está corriendo: abortar primero

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ hilo del programa
    def _program(self):
        src = (ROOT / "software" / "robot" / "rover_x_auto.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        src = src.rstrip()
        if src.endswith("main()"):
            src = src[:-len("main()")]
        ns = {"__name__": "rover_x_auto"}
        exec(compile(src, "rover_x_auto.py", "exec"), ns)
        return ns["main"]

    def _run(self):
        import cyberpi
        cyberpi.console.println = lambda t: self.log.append((world.t, "CyberPi: %s" % t))
        cyberpi.console.print = cyberpi.console.println
        if self.mode == "user":
            return self._run_user()
        if self.mode == "manual":
            return self._run_manual()
        self._run_comp()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ solo manual (gamepad)
    def _run_manual(self):
        import manual
        hal.time = types.SimpleNamespace(sleep=self.sleep)
        self.log.append((world.t, "MANUAL: usa el control emulado (o el teclado)"))
        try:
            while not self.stop:
                try:
                    manual.loop()
                except physics.Fallen as e:
                    self._fallen(e)
                hal.clear_abort()
        except Stop:
            pass

    def _fallen(self, e):
        self.sim.falls += 1
        self.state = "Se cayó: %s. Usa Colocar en la zona" % e
        while not self.stop:
            with self.lock:
                if "place" in self.pending:
                    self.pending.remove("place")
                    break
            REAL_SLEEP(0.05)
        self.place(self.screen_level() or self.level)
        self.state = ""

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ programa subido
    def _run_user(self):
        runner = userprog.Runner(world, self._user_step, self.log, on_idle=self._user_idle,
                                 speed=lambda: self.speed, paused=lambda: self.paused)
        self.runner = runner
        self.log.append((world.t, "PROGRAMA SUBIDO: %s" % self.prog_name))
        old_sleep, old_time = time.sleep, time.time
        time.sleep, time.time = runner.sleep, runner.now
        hal.time = time
        try:
            runner.run(self.source)
        finally:
            time.sleep, time.time = old_sleep, old_time

    def _user_step(self, dt):
        if self.sim.fallen:                  # caído: el reloj sigue, el robot no
            world.t += dt
            return
        try:
            self.sim.sleep(dt)
        except physics.Fallen as e:
            self.sim.falls += 1
            self.state = "Se cayó: %s. Usa Colocar en la zona" % e

    def _user_idle(self):
        if self.stop:
            self.runner.stop = True
            return
        for t, b in list(self.releases):
            if world.t >= t:
                world.pressed.discard(b)
                self.releases.remove((t, b))
        with self.lock:
            want = "place" in self.pending
            if want:
                self.pending.remove("place")
        if want:
            self.place(self.level)
            self.state = ""
        if self.runner.error and not self.state:
            self.state = "Error del programa: " + self.runner.error

    def _run_comp(self):
        hal.time = types.SimpleNamespace(sleep=self.sleep)
        orig_rm = autonomous.run_mission

        def run_mission(m):
            self.label = "M%d %s" % (m["id"], m["name"])
            self.log.append((world.t, "PROGRAMA: empieza " + self.label))
            ok = orig_rm(m)
            self.log.append((world.t, "PROGRAMA: %s %s" % (self.label, "OK" if ok else "FALLA")))
            self.results.append((m["id"], ok))
            return ok
        autonomous.run_mission = run_mission
        orig_rs = autonomous.run_step

        def run_step(st):
            self.sim.program_step = st[0]
            return orig_rs(st)
        autonomous.run_step = run_step
        autonomous.completed.clear()
        main = self._program()
        try:
            if self.sim.start_held:
                hal.servo(cfg.SERVO_CLAW, cfg.P["claw_ball"])
                self.sim.place_start_object()
            while not self.stop:
                try:
                    main()                       # el programa de competencia (no termina solo)
                except physics.Fallen as e:
                    self.sim.falls += 1
                    self.state = "Se cayó: %s. Usa Colocar en la zona" % e
                    while not self.stop:         # esperar a que el equipo lo levante
                        with self.lock:
                            if "place" in self.pending:
                                self.pending.remove("place")
                                break
                        REAL_SLEEP(0.05)
                    self.place(self.screen_level() or self.zone_level())
                    self.state = ""
        except Stop:
            pass
        finally:
            autonomous.run_mission = orig_rm
            autonomous.run_step = orig_rs

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ estado para la página
    def snapshot(self, nf, ne):
        with self.lock:
            frames = self.frames[nf:]
            events = [(round(t, 2), e) for t, e in self.log[ne:]]
        prog = {}
        for mid, ok in list(self.results):
            prog[mid] = prog.get(mid, False) or ok
        return {
            "frames": frames, "events": events,
            "status": {"state": self.state,
                       "t": round(world.t, 1), "speed": self.speed, "paused": self.paused,
                       "restarts": len(self.sim.restarts), "falls": self.sim.falls,
                       "screen": [world.labels.get(k, "") for k in range(4)]},
            "judge": self.ref.snapshot(), "program": prog,
        }

    def init_data(self):
        return {
            "live": True, "report": {"missions": [], "program": {}, "program_points": 0, "total": 0,
                                     "notes": [], "warnings": ra.geometry_warnings(), "error": None},
            "frames": [], "events": [], "arena": self.arena.to_json(),
            "robot": physics.robot_view(cfg.P),
            "params": dict(self.params, prog={}, true={}, cards=self.arena.card_colors,
                           ramp_deg=None),
            "missions": [{"id": m["id"], "name": m["name"], "pts": m["pts"], "level": m["level"]}
                         for m in (manual_sim.MISSIONS if self.mode == "manual" else ms.MISSIONS)],
        }


SESSION = None


def new_session(**kw):
    global SESSION
    if SESSION is not None:
        SESSION.stop = True
        SESSION.paused = False
        if getattr(SESSION, "runner", None) is not None:
            SESSION.runner.stop = True
        SESSION.thread.join(timeout=5)
    SESSION = Session(**kw)
    SESSION.thread.start()
    return SESSION


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass

    def _send(self, body, ctype="application/json"):
        data = body.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(body, str) else body
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype + "; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def do_GET(self):
        u = urlparse(self.path)
        q = {k: v[0] for k, v in parse_qs(u.query).items()}
        s = SESSION
        if u.path == "/":
            html = viewer.TEMPLATE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            html = html.replace("/*__DATA__*/null", json.dumps(s.init_data(), ensure_ascii=False))
            return self._send(html, "text/html")
        if u.path == "/state":
            return self._send(json.dumps(s.snapshot(int(q.get("f", 0)), int(q.get("e", 0))),
                                         ensure_ascii=False))
        self.send_error(404)

    def do_POST(self):
        u = urlparse(self.path)
        q = {k: v[0] for k, v in parse_qs(u.query).items()}
        s = SESSION
        cmd = u.path.strip("/")
        if cmd == "upload":
            n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
            data = self.rfile.read(n) if n else b""
            name = q.get("name", "programa.py")
            try:
                src, desc = userprog.source_from_upload(name, data)
                compile(src, "programa", "exec")
            except (ValueError, SyntaxError) as e:
                return self._send(json.dumps({"error": str(e)}, ensure_ascii=False))
            new_session(level=int(q.get("level", 1)), seed=int(q.get("seed", 0)),
                        noise=float(q.get("noise", 0)), source=src, prog_name=desc)
            return self._send(json.dumps({"reload": True}))
        if cmd == "pad":
            n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
            try:
                st = json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")
            except ValueError:
                st = {}
            if st.get("on", True):
                world.pad = set(st.get("keys", []))
                world.axes = {k: float(st.get(k, 0)) for k in ("Lx", "Ly", "Rx", "Ry")}
            else:
                world.pad = set()
                world.axes = {}
            return self._send(json.dumps({"ok": True}))
        if cmd == "btn" and q.get("k") in ("up", "down", "left", "right", "middle", "a", "b"):
            s.press(q["k"], hold=0.25)
        elif cmd == "place":
            s.command("place")
        elif cmd == "pause":
            s.paused = not s.paused
        elif cmd == "speed":
            s.speed = float(q.get("v", 1))
        elif cmd == "new":
            mode = q.get("mode", "comp")
            if mode == "user" and s.source:
                new_session(level=int(q.get("level", 1)), seed=int(q.get("seed", 0)),
                            noise=float(q.get("noise", 0)), source=s.source,
                            prog_name=s.prog_name)
            else:
                new_session(level=int(q.get("level", 1)), seed=int(q.get("seed", 0)),
                            noise=float(q.get("noise", 0)),
                            mode="manual" if mode == "manual" else "comp")
            return self._send(json.dumps({"reload": True}))
        else:
            return self.send_error(404)
        self._send(json.dumps({"ok": True}))


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Simulador en vivo de Rover X")
    ap.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8770)
    ap.add_argument("--level", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--noise", type=float, default=0.0)
    ap.add_argument("--no-open", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--manual", action="store_true", help="solo control manual (gamepad emulado)")
    ap.add_argument("--program", help="correr este .py o .mblock en vez del de competencia")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if a.program:
        data = Path(a.program).read_bytes()
        src, desc = userprog.source_from_upload(Path(a.program).name, data)
        new_session(level=a.level, seed=a.seed, noise=a.noise, source=src, prog_name=desc)
    else:
        new_session(level=a.level, seed=a.seed, noise=a.noise,
                    mode="manual" if a.manual else "comp")
    srv = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", a.port), Handler)
    url = "http://127.0.0.1:%d/" % a.port
    print("Simulador en vivo: %s  (Ctrl+C para salir)" % url)
    if not a.no_open:
        webbrowser.open(url)
    try:
        srv.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

Reconstruida de la vista superior del reglamento
(resources/reglamento/arena/arena_manual_superior.png, 814 x 427 px). La arena mide
2440 x 1220 mm (la otra mitad de la pista de 2440 x 2440): 3 tableros a lo ancho y 2 a lo alto.
En la imagen la arena va de x = 12 a 788 px y de y = 26 a 404 px.

- Escaleras: dos dobles (dos tramos separados 12 cm), una a cada lado, suben hacia el centro.
- Rampas abatibles: empiezan LEVANTADAS (de pie en la orilla del nivel 2, como un puente
  levadizo). Desde el nivel 2 el robot las empuja y caen hacia afuera: quedan como rampa
  (misión de alianza 2, 30 pts c/u + 40 si son las dos).
- Barra MakeX (magenta) arriba del nivel 2 con 5 lugares para los cubos M-A-K-E-X.
- Cubos con letra sobre pedestales (6 x 6 x 10 cm); 4 cilindros (5 x 15 cm) en las esquinas del
  tablero rojo/morado; el área negra es el círculo del centro de ese tablero.

Medidas DEL REGLAMENTO: pista 2440 x 2440 mm (esta mitad: 2440 x 1220, 3 tableros de 813 x 610 mm),
escalera de 8 peldaños de 2.5 cm (nivel 2 = 20 cm) con huella de 3.7 cm y 12 cm entre tramos,
rampas de 22 cm de ancho mínimo y 40° máximo (aquí 23 cm y ~33°), pedestales de 6 x 6 x 10 cm,
cubos de 50 mm, cilindros de 5 cm de diámetro x 15 cm, huecos de hasta 10 mm.
Medidas DEL DIBUJO A ESCALA (el reglamento no las da): posición de todo, círculo negro (~19 cm de
radio), barra MakeX (57 x 6 cm; alto supuesto 10 cm como la barra de pelotas) y el mecanismo
de las rampas. TODO(pista): confirmarlas en la pista real.

Marco en cm: x hacia la derecha de la imagen, y hacia ARRIBA, origen en la esquina inferior
izquierda.
"""

import math

import arena as ar

SX = 244.0 / (788 - 12)          # cm por pixel a lo ancho
SY = 122.0 / (404 - 26)          # cm por pixel a lo alto
W_CM = 244.0
H_CM = 122.0


def px(x, y):
    return ((x - 12) * SX, (404 - y) * SY)


def rect_px(x0, y0, x1, y1):
    a, b = px(x0, y0), px(x1, y1)
    return (min(a[0], b[0]), min(a[1], b[1]), max(a[0], b[0]), max(a[1], b[1]))


X_L2 = (271 - 12) * SX           # orilla izquierda del nivel 2 (81.4 cm)
X_R2 = (529 - 12) * SX           # orilla derecha (162.6 cm)
Z = {1: 0.0, 2: 20.0}            # escalera de 8 x 2.5 cm

PEDESTAL = 6.0
PEDESTAL_H = 10.0
CUBE = 5.0
CYL_D = 5.0
CYL_H = 15.0
BAR_H = 10.0                     # TODO(pista) alto de la barra MakeX
LETTERS = "MAKEX"

STAIR_STEPS = 8
STAIR_RISE = 2.5
# dos tramos por escalera (y en px: 83-101 y 140-158); la izquierda sube hacia +x, la derecha hacia -x
FLIGHTS_Y_PX = [(83, 101), (140, 158)]
STAIR_RUN = STAIR_STEPS * 3.7    # huella de 3.7 cm


def _flight_rects(side):
    out = []
    for y0, y1 in FLIGHTS_Y_PX:
        _, ya = px(0, y1)
        _, yb = px(0, y0)
        if side < 0:

"""Física de la ARENA MANUAL (misiones de alianza) sobre physics.Sim.

Objetos sueltos (cubos M-A-K-E-X y cilindros de 5 x 15 cm) con una dinámica sencilla pero creíble:
- El robot (chasis y garra) los EMPUJA: se deslizan alejándose del punto de contacto, el cubo gira
  si se empuja de lado, y empujan a otros objetos. Contra un pedestal, la barra o una rampa
  levantada se atoran y frenan al robot.
- Un cilindro parado se VOLTEA si lo golpean arriba de ~60 % de su altura (la garra alta) o rápido
  (> 28 cm/s); al caer de un nivel o al soltarlo desde más de 2.5 cm también se voltea.
- Gravedad: si lo que tienen debajo desaparece (orilla de un nivel, pedestal) caen a lo de abajo.
- La garra los toma solo si están entre los dedos, a la altura correcta y la garra cierra lo
  suficiente (separación de los dedos < ancho del objeto). Abrirla los suelta: caen sobre lo que
  haya debajo (piso, pedestal, lugar de la barra).
- Un cilindro que se carga y toca el piso se resbala hacia arriba entre los dedos.

Rampas: empiezan levantadas (pared en la orilla del nivel 2). Desde el nivel 2, empujarlas hacia
afuera las tumba: quedan como rampa.
"""

import math

import arena as ar
import manual_arena as ma
import physics

FRONT = -90.0                   # "de frente" = la letra mira hacia -y (hacia los equipos)
BODY_H = 12.0                   # alto del chasis que empuja (cm)
BODY_PUSH_H = 6.0               # altura a la que empuja el frente (orugas): no voltea un cilindro
TIP_SPEED = 28.0                # cm/s: un golpe más rápido voltea un cilindro parado
TIP_FRAC = 0.6                  # contacto arriba de esta fracción de la altura -> se voltea
PALM_SLIDE_SPEED = 30.0         # cm/s: más rápido, la palma tira el objeto del pedestal
GRIP_MIN_GAP = 4.6              # separación de los dedos con la garra en claw_cube (cm)


def _norm(a):
    return (a + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0


class ManualSim(physics.Sim):
    def _initial_pose(self, level):
        return self.arena.start_pose(level)

    def _init_objects(self, level):
        a = self.arena
        letters = list(ma.LETTERS)
        self.rng.shuffle(letters)
        self.objects = {}
        for k, L in enumerate(letters):
            r = a.props["pedestal%d" % (k + 1)][0]
            cx, cy = (r[0] + r[2]) / 2, (r[1] + r[3]) / 2
            top = a.height(cx, cy) + ma.PEDESTAL_H
            self.objects[L] = {"kind": "cube", "x": cx, "y": cy, "z": top + ma.CUBE / 2, "yaw": 0.0,
                               "face": self.rng.choice((0.0, 90.0, 180.0, -90.0)),
                               "upright": True, "held": False, "on": "pedestal%d" % (k + 1)}
        for k, (cx, cy) in enumerate(a.cylinders0):
            self.objects["c%d" % (k + 1)] = {"kind": "cyl", "x": cx, "y": cy,
                                             "z": a.height(cx, cy) + ma.CYL_H / 2, "yaw": 0.0,
                                             "face": 0.0, "upright": True, "held": False,
                                             "on": "piso"}
        self.prism = {"x": -50.0, "y": -50.0, "half": 3.2, "lost": True}
        self._gap_prev = None
        self._stuck_logged = -9.0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ forma de los objetos
    @staticmethod
    def half_h(o):
        if o["kind"] == "cube":
            return ma.CUBE / 2
        return ma.CYL_H / 2 if o["upright"] else ma.CYL_D / 2

    @staticmethod
    def width(o):
        return ma.CUBE if o["kind"] == "cube" else ma.CYL_D

    @staticmethod
    def poly(o, x=None, y=None, yaw=None):
        x = o["x"] if x is None else x
        y = o["y"] if y is None else y
        yaw = o["yaw"] if yaw is None else yaw
        if o["kind"] == "cube":
            return ar.rect_poly(x, y, math.radians(yaw), ma.CUBE, ma.CUBE)
        if o["upright"]:
            r = ma.CYL_D / 2
            return [(x + r * math.cos(k * math.pi / 4), y + r * math.sin(k * math.pi / 4)) for k in range(8)]
        return ar.rect_poly(x, y, math.radians(yaw), ma.CYL_H, ma.CYL_D)

    def _name(self, n):
        return ("el cubo %s" % n) if self.objects[n]["kind"] == "cube" else ("el cilindro %s" % n[1:])

    def support(self, x, y):
        """Altura de lo que hay debajo de (x, y): piso, pedestal o barra (None = fuera)."""
        a = self.arena
        z = a.height(x, y)
        if z is None:
            return None
        for name, (r, h, _) in a.props.items():
            if ar.inside(r, x, y):
                z = max(z, a.height((r[0] + r[2]) / 2, (r[1] + r[3]) / 2) + h)
        return z

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ garra
    def gap(self):
        """Separación entre el dedo y la placa (cm): claw_open_w abierta, GRIP_MIN_GAP en claw_cube."""
        f = self.claw_open_frac()
        return GRIP_MIN_GAP + f * (self.body.get("claw_open_w", 9.0) - GRIP_MIN_GAP)

    def claw_z(self):
        return self.claw_point()[2]

    def update_gripper(self):
        g = self.gap()
        prev = self._gap_prev if self._gap_prev is not None else g
        self._gap_prev = g
        if self.held is None and g < prev:          # cerrando
            cx, cy, cz = self.claw_point()
            r = self.claw_reach()
            lat = self.body.get("arm_lat", 0.0)
            for name, o in self.objects.items():
                if o["held"] or o["on"] == "fuera":
                    continue
                w = self.width(o)
                if g > w - 0.2 or prev <= w - 0.2:    # aprieta justo en este paso (no antes ni después)
                    continue
                if o["kind"] == "cyl" and not o["upright"]:
                    continue
                f, l = self._local(o["x"], o["y"])
                # el dedo barre el objeto contra la placa fija: basta con que estuviera entre ellos
                side = max(0.6, (self.body.get("claw_open_w", 9.0) - w) / 2.0 + 0.3)
                # entre la palma y casi la punta de los dedos (claw_tip); más afuera se resbala
                if not (-1.0 <= f - r <= self.body["claw_tip"] - 0.3) or abs(l - lat) > side:
                    continue
                hh = self.half_h(o)
                if o["kind"] == "cube":
                    if abs(o["z"] - cz) > 2.0:
                        continue
                elif not (o["z"] - hh + 1.5 <= cz <= o["z"] + hh - 1.0):
                    continue
                self.held = name
                o.update(held=True, on=None, dz=o["z"] - cz, df=f - r, dyaw=_norm(o["yaw"] - self.yaw),
                         dface=_norm(o["face"] - self.yaw))
                self.log.append((self.world.t, "toma %s" % self._name(name)))
                break
        elif self.held is not None and g > self.width(self.objects[self.held]) + 0.3:
            self._release()
        if self.held:
            self._carry()

    def _carry(self):
        o = self.objects[self.held]
        cx, cy, cz = self.claw_point()
        c, s_ = self.frame()
        df = o.get("df", 0.0) * math.cos(math.radians(self.pitch))
        o["x"], o["y"] = cx + c * df, cy + s_ * df
        o["yaw"] = self.yaw + o.get("dyaw", 0.0)
        o["face"] = self.yaw + o.get("dface", 0.0)
        o["z"] = cz + o.get("dz", 0.0)
        s = self.support(o["x"], o["y"])
        bottom = o["z"] - self.half_h(o)
        if s is not None and bottom < s:
            # toca el piso: se resbala hacia arriba entre los dedos (no atraviesa el piso)
            o["dz"] = o.get("dz", 0.0) + (s - bottom)
            o["z"] = s + self.half_h(o)
            if self.world.t - self._hit_logged.get("objeto-piso", -9) > 1.0:
                self.log.append((self.world.t, "%s toca el piso y se resbala en la garra"
                                 % self._name(self.held)))
            self._hit_logged["objeto-piso"] = self.world.t

    def _release(self):
        name = self.held
        o = self.objects[name]
        self.held = None
        o["held"] = False
        a = self.arena
        where = None
        bottom = o["z"] - self.half_h(o)
        if o["kind"] == "cube":
            bar = a.props["bar"]
            top = (a.height((bar[0][0] + bar[0][2]) / 2, (bar[0][1] + bar[0][3]) / 2) or 0.0) + bar[1]
            for k, (sx, sy) in enumerate(a.slots):
                if math.hypot(o["x"] - sx, o["y"] - sy) <= 2.2 and bottom >= top - 1.5:
                    busy = any(p is not o and p.get("on") == "barra%d" % (k + 1) for p in self.objects.values())
                    if busy:
                        continue
                    snap = round(o["yaw"] / 90.0) * 90.0 - o["yaw"]
                    o.update(x=sx, y=sy, z=top + ma.CUBE / 2, yaw=o["yaw"] + snap, face=o["face"] + snap)
                    where = "barra%d" % (k + 1)
                    break
        if where is None:
            s = self.support(o["x"], o["y"])
            if s is None:
                where = "fuera"
                o["z"] = -10.0
            else:
                drop = bottom - s
                if o["kind"] == "cyl" and drop > 2.5:
                    self._tip(o, self.yaw + self.rng.uniform(-60, 60), "se cae al soltarlo")
                    s = self.support(o["x"], o["y"])
                    s = 0.0 if s is None else s
                o["z"] = s + self.half_h(o)
                where = self._where(o)
        o["on"] = where
        self.log.append((self.world.t, "suelta %s en %s" % (self._name(name), where)))

    def _where(self, o):
        a = self.arena
        for pname, (r, h, _) in a.props.items():
            if ar.inside(r, o["x"], o["y"]):
                return pname
        lvl = a.surface(o["x"], o["y"])
        return "nivel %s" % lvl if isinstance(lvl, int) else str(lvl)

    def _tip(self, o, direction, why):
        """Voltea un cilindro parado hacia `direction` (grados): queda acostado."""
        if o["kind"] != "cyl" or not o["upright"]:
            return
        d = math.radians(direction)
        o["upright"] = False
        o["yaw"] = direction
        base = o["z"] - ma.CYL_H / 2
        o["x"] += math.cos(d) * (ma.CYL_H - ma.CYL_D) / 2
        o["y"] += math.sin(d) * (ma.CYL_H - ma.CYL_D) / 2
        s = self.support(o["x"], o["y"])
        o["z"] = (base if s is None else s) + ma.CYL_D / 2
        self.log.append((self.world.t, "%s %s" % (self._name([k for k, v in self.objects.items() if v is o][0]), why)))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ empujar
    def palm_poly(self, x, y, yaw):
        """Fondo de la garra (lo que empuja a un objeto que está entre los dedos abiertos)."""
        r = self.claw_reach() - 2.5 - 0.5
        lat = self.body.get("arm_lat", 0.0)
        c, s = math.cos(math.radians(yaw)), math.sin(math.radians(yaw))
        return ar.rect_poly(x + c * r - s * lat, y + s * r + c * lat, math.radians(yaw), 1.0, 6.0)

    @staticmethod
    def _local_at(x, y, rx, ry, ryaw):
        c, s = math.cos(math.radians(ryaw)), math.sin(math.radians(ryaw))
        dx, dy = x - rx, y - ry
        return dx * c + dy * s, -dx * s + dy * c

    def _obstacle(self, o, poly):
        """¿El objeto en esa forma choca con algo fijo (pedestal, barra, rampa levantada, pared de
        un nivel más alto)?"""
        a = self.arena
        lo, hi = o["z"] - self.half_h(o), o["z"] + self.half_h(o)
        for name, (r, h, _) in a.props.items():
            base = a.height((r[0] + r[2]) / 2, (r[1] + r[3]) / 2) or 0.0
            if lo < base + h - 0.3 and hi > base and ar.polys_overlap(poly, ar.rect_to_poly(r)):
                return name
        for p, q in a.walls:
            if hi > ma.Z[2] - 0.5 and lo < ma.Z[2] + ma.RAMP_UP_H and ar.poly_seg_overlap(poly, p, q):
                return "rampa levantada"
        for qx, qy in poly:
            z = a.height(qx, qy)
            if z is not None and z > lo + 1.0:
                return "pared del nivel"
        return None

    def _push(self, rx, ry, ryaw, commit):
        """Empuja los objetos que toca el robot en la pose (rx, ry, ryaw). Devuelve False si alguno
        queda atorado (el robot no puede avanzar)."""
        fp = self.footprint(rx, ry, ryaw)
        cp = self.claw_poly(rx, ry, ryaw)
        reach = self.claw_reach()
        lat = self.body.get("arm_lat", 0.0)
        gap = self.gap()
        palm = self.palm_poly(rx, ry, ryaw)
        rz = self.arena.height(rx, ry)
        rz = self.z if rz is None else rz
        h, _ = self.arm_h()
        cz = rz + h
        v = (self.vl + self.vr) / 2.0
        if abs(self.vl) + abs(self.vr) < 0.5:       # quieto: no empuja (soltar en la barra, etc.)
            return True
        c, s = math.cos(math.radians(ryaw)), math.sin(math.radians(ryaw))
        hx, hy = (c, s) if v >= 0 else (-c, -s)
        state = {}
        ok = True
        for name, o in self.objects.items():
            if o["held"] or o["on"] == "fuera":
                continue
            hh = self.half_h(o)
            lo, hi = o["z"] - hh, o["z"] + hh
            P = self.poly(o)
            by_body = lo < rz + BODY_H and hi > rz + 0.5 and ar.polys_overlap(fp, P)
            # entre los dedos abiertos el objeto no se empuja: solo la palma (el fondo de la garra)
            cpo = cp
            if gap > self.width(o) - 0.2:               # el dedo todavía no lo aprieta
                f, l = self._local_at(o["x"], o["y"], rx, ry, ryaw)
                if abs(l - lat) <= (self.body.get("claw_open_w", 9.0) - self.width(o)) / 2.0 + 0.3:
                    cpo = palm
            by_claw = lo < cz + 3.0 and hi > cz - 3.0 and ar.polys_overlap(cpo, P)
            cp_hit = cpo
            if not (by_body or by_claw):
                continue
            # un objeto sobre un pedestal o en la barra tiene fricción: la palma lo TOCA y el robot
            # se detiene ahí (listo para cerrar la garra); solo un golpe rápido lo tira
            if (by_claw and not by_body and cpo is palm and abs(v) < PALM_SLIDE_SPEED
                    and str(o.get("on", "")).startswith(("pedestal", "barra"))):
                ok = False
                if commit is False and self.world.t - self._stuck_logged > 1.5:
                    self._stuck_logged = self.world.t
                    self.log.append((self.world.t, "la garra toca %s: ciérrala para tomarlo"
                                     % self._name(name)))
                continue
            dx, dy = o["x"] - rx, o["y"] - ry
            n = math.hypot(dx, dy) or 1.0
            ux, uy = dx / n, dy / n
            px_, py_ = 0.6 * hx + 0.4 * ux, 0.6 * hy + 0.4 * uy
            m = math.hypot(px_, py_) or 1.0
            px_, py_ = px_ / m, py_ / m
            x, y, yaw = o["x"], o["y"], o["yaw"]
            moved = 0.0
            for _ in range(48):
                Q = self.poly(o, x, y, yaw)
                if not ((by_body and ar.polys_overlap(fp, Q)) or (by_claw and ar.polys_overlap(cp_hit, Q))):
                    break
                x += px_ * 0.25
                y += py_ * 0.25
                moved += 0.25
                if o["kind"] == "cube" or not o["upright"]:
                    yaw += 6.0 * (hx * uy - hy * ux)          # empujado de lado: gira
            if moved == 0.0:
                continue
            hit = self._obstacle(o, self.poly(o, x, y, yaw))
            if hit:
                ok = False
                if commit is False and self.world.t - self._stuck_logged > 1.0:
                    self._stuck_logged = self.world.t
                    self.log.append((self.world.t, "%s se atora contra %s" % (self._name(name), hit)))
                continue
            state[name] = (x, y, yaw, by_claw, moved)
        if not commit:
            return ok
        for name, (x, y, yaw, by_claw, moved) in state.items():
            o = self.objects[name]
            dyaw = yaw - o["yaw"]
            o["x"], o["y"], o["yaw"] = x, y, yaw
            if o["kind"] == "cube":
                o["face"] += dyaw
            if not o.get("pushed_log") or self.world.t - o["pushed_log"] > 2.0:
                self.log.append((self.world.t, "empuja %s" % self._name(name)))
            o["pushed_log"] = self.world.t
            if o["kind"] == "cyl" and o["upright"]:
                contact = (cz if by_claw else rz + BODY_PUSH_H) - (o["z"] - ma.CYL_H / 2)
                if contact > TIP_FRAC * ma.CYL_H or abs(v) > TIP_SPEED:
                    self._tip(o, math.degrees(math.atan2(hy, hx)), "se voltea (golpe %s)" %
                              ("alto" if contact > TIP_FRAC * ma.CYL_H else "rápido"))
            o["on"] = self._where(o)
        self._separate()
        return ok

    def _separate(self):
        """Objetos encimados se separan (uno empuja al otro)."""
        names = [n for n, o in self.objects.items() if not o["held"] and o["on"] != "fuera"]
        for _ in range(3):
            moved = False
            for i, a_ in enumerate(names):
                for b_ in names[i + 1:]:
                    A, B = self.objects[a_], self.objects[b_]
                    if abs(A["z"] - B["z"]) > self.half_h(A) + self.half_h(B):
                        continue
                    if not ar.polys_overlap(self.poly(A), self.poly(B)):
                        continue
                    dx, dy = B["x"] - A["x"], B["y"] - A["y"]
                    n = math.hypot(dx, dy) or 1.0
                    for _k in range(16):
                        nx, ny = B["x"] + dx / n * 0.25, B["y"] + dy / n * 0.25
                        if self._obstacle(B, self.poly(B, nx, ny)):
                            break
                        B["x"], B["y"] = nx, ny
                        moved = True
                        if not ar.polys_overlap(self.poly(A), self.poly(B)):
                            break
            if not moved:
                break

    def _gravity(self):
        for name, o in self.objects.items():
            if o["held"] or o["on"] == "fuera":
                continue
            s = self.support(o["x"], o["y"])
            if s is None:
                o["on"] = "fuera"
                o["z"] = -10.0
                self.log.append((self.world.t, "%s se sale de la arena" % self._name(name)))
                continue
            bottom = o["z"] - self.half_h(o)
            if bottom > s + 0.3:
                drop = bottom - s
                if o["kind"] == "cyl" and o["upright"] and drop > 2.5:
                    self._tip(o, o["yaw"] if o["yaw"] else self.rng.uniform(-180, 180), "se cae y se voltea")
                    s = self.support(o["x"], o["y"])
                    s = 0.0 if s is None else s
                o["z"] = s + self.half_h(o)
                o["on"] = self._where(o)
                self.log.append((self.world.t, "%s cae %.0f cm (%s)" % (self._name(name), drop, o["on"])))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ rampas y choques
    def _ramp_push(self, x, y, yaw):
        a = self.arena
        if self.z < ma.Z[2] - 3.0:
            return
        fp = self.footprint(x, y, yaw)
        cp = self.claw_poly(x, y, yaw)
        v = (self.vl + self.vr) / 2.0
        for i, r in enumerate(a.ramps):
            if r["active"]:
                continue
            p, q = (r["hinge_x"], r["rect"][1]), (r["hinge_x"], r["rect"][3])
            if not (ar.poly_seg_overlap(fp, p, q) or ar.poly_seg_overlap(cp, p, q)):
                continue
            toward = math.cos(math.radians(yaw)) * r["out"] * (1 if v >= 0 else -1)
            if toward > 0.3 and abs(v) > 1.0:
                a.activate(i)
                self.ramp_t = getattr(self, "ramp_t", {})
                self.ramp_t[i] = self.world.t
                self.log.append((self.world.t, "activa la rampa %s (cae hacia afuera)" % r["name"]))

    def _blocked(self, x, y, yaw):
        self._ramp_push(x, y, yaw)
        if super()._blocked(x, y, yaw):
            return True
        return not self._push(x, y, yaw, commit=False)

    def _objects_step(self):
        self._push(self.x, self.y, self.yaw, commit=True)
        self._gravity()

    def place(self, level, noise=None):
        x, y, yaw = self.arena.start_pose(level)
        n = self.noise if noise is None else noise
        self.x = x + self.rng.gauss(0, 0.7) * n
        self.y = y + self.rng.gauss(0, 0.7) * n
        self.yaw = yaw + self.rng.gauss(0, 1.5) * n
        self._last_yaw = self.yaw
        self.vl = self.vr = 0.0
        self.acc = 0.0
        self.z = self.arena.height(self.x, self.y)
        self._update_pitch()
        self.fallen = None
        self.contacts = set()
        if self.held:
            self._carry()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ cuadros para el visor
    def frame_extra(self):
        objs = []
        for name, o in self.objects.items():
            objs.append([name, o["kind"], round(o["x"], 1), round(o["y"], 1), round(o["z"], 1),
                         round(o["yaw"], 0), 1 if o["upright"] else 0, 1 if o["held"] else 0,
                         round(_norm(o["face"]), 0)])
        return [objs, [1 if r["active"] else 0 for r in self.arena.ramps]]

class ManualReferee:
    """Puntos de las misiones de alianza (estado actual de la arena)."""

    def __init__(self, sim):
        self.sim = sim
        self.done = {}
        self.first = {}

    def score(self):
        s = self.sim
        a = s.arena
        on_bar = {}
        for name, o in s.objects.items():
            if o["kind"] == "cube" and not o["held"] and str(o.get("on", "")).startswith("barra"):
                on_bar[int(o["on"][5:]) - 1] = (name, o)
        letters = len(on_bar)
        word = (letters == 5 and all(on_bar[k][0] == ma.LETTERS[k] for k in range(5))
                and all(abs(_norm(on_bar[k][1]["face"] - FRONT)) < 45 for k in range(5)))
        ramps = sum(1 for r in a.ramps if r["active"])
        cyl = 0
        for o in s.objects.values():
            if o["kind"] == "cyl" and o["upright"] and not o["held"] and \
                    abs(o["z"] - ma.CYL_H / 2 - ma.Z[2]) < 0.5 and a.in_disc(o["x"], o["y"], ma.CYL_D / 2):
                cyl += 1
        return {"A1": (letters > 0, 50 * letters), "A1+": (word, 100 if word else 0),
                "A2": (ramps > 0, 30 * ramps), "A2+": (ramps == 2, 40 if ramps == 2 else 0),
                "A3": (cyl > 0, 50 * cyl)}

    def update(self):
        t = self.sim.world.t
        for k, (ok, pts) in self.score().items():
            if ok and k not in self.first:
                self.first[k] = t
            if not ok:
                self.first.pop(k, None)

    def snapshot(self):
        out = []
        for m in MISSIONS:
            ok, pts = self.score()[m["id"]]
            out.append({"id": m["id"], "ok": ok, "pts": pts, "t": self.first.get(m["id"])})
        return out
